title: Preallocate DROP INDEX prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DROP INDEX single-column cleanup builds index:<table>:<column>: prefixes from known table and column name lengths.

result: DROP INDEX single-column prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table and column name lengths while preserving index-entry cleanup and SQL index behavior.
